items.title: X post from @oscarsspiastree: Q: Did you pick up any damage from the contact with George? "Not that I'm aware of. I don't thi…

items.summary: Q: Did you pick up any damage from the contact with George? "Not that I'm aware of. I don't think it did anything. But I mean the car, more or less, felt the same it did all weekend so...yeah. A difficult one. At least we could keep George behind after the stops but um just a tricky weekend."

items.summary: Q: If this race becomes a battle for strategy rather than pure pace, how aggressive are you willing to be with the tyre life and pitstop timing? "I think from where I'm starting, we've not got too much to lose. So we'll see how the first lap goes and the start goes but yeah. It's gonna be an unknown for everybody. I think whether it's a one stop, two stop. Whether you're on a soft, medium, hard. We're in a reasonable position to take some risk from that side of things."
